Old voices from childhood can still shape how you think about money.

Kevin Trudeau explains that when you practice saying a big goal out loud, old programming can come to the surface. A guidance counselor who said you would never amount to anything. A parent who said you would struggle your whole life.

He says that is exactly why the exercise is worth doing. The words bring up what you absorbed long ago, so you can see it for what it is.

What you were told as a kid may still be running your adult choices.

Whose voice do you hear when you think about money?
